meta.name: taskflow
meta.description: Use when work should span one or more detached tasks but still behave like one job with a single owner context. TaskFlow is the durable flow substrate under authoring layers like Lobster, ACPX, plugins, or plain code. Keep conditional logic in the caller; use TaskFlow for flow identity, child-task linkage, waiting state, revision-checked mutations, and user-facing emergence.

copy.tagline: 将多个独立任务编排为有状态的工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个任务间保持上下文和状态
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate detached tasks into a stateful workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to maintain context and state across multiple tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以创建和管理持久化的多步骤工作流。这些工作流能跨越多次对话独立运行，但共享同一个会话上下文，并支持等待外部事件、保存状态、恢复执行等操作。
howto.when: 当需要执行一系列步骤，且这些步骤可能跨越多个独立运行（如后台任务、子代理），但仍需像单一任务一样被管理和恢复时触发。

say.text: 创建一个收件箱分类工作流，先分类再等待审核。
say.note: 会启动一个多步骤任务，并进入等待状态。

say.text: 恢复之前暂停的流程，继续下一步。
say.note: 将之前 setWaiting 的任务标记为可继续。

say.text: 取消当前运行中的工作流。
say.note: 会终止任务并取消关联的子任务。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can create and manage persistent multi-step workflows. These workflows can span multiple detached runs but share a single session context, supporting waiting for external events, state persistence, and resumption.
howto.when_en: Use when work should span one or more detached tasks (e.g., multi-step background work, subagent tasks) but still behave like one job with a single owner context that can be inspected or resumed.

say_en.text: Create an inbox triage workflow that classifies and waits for approval.
say_en.note: Starts a multi-step task and enters waiting state.

say_en.text: Resume the previously paused flow and continue.
say_en.note: Marks a setWaiting flow as ready to proceed.
Terminates the flow and cancels linked child tasks.
